  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.

      properties:
        type:

          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'

        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepts spaces, dashes and
            brackets and an optional leading '+' with country code on input; stored and
            returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). A number without a
            country code is assumed to be '+61' with a single leading '0' dropped.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+()0-9 -]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to the current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Create-only flag. When true, the owner may share a last name and
            address with an existing owner (the household-duplicate rule is bypassed).
            Not persisted and never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:

              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>'
                where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN a per-city 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence (one more than the owners already in that city).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'

              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID

              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F60718'
              readOnly: true

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1

              type: string
              example: 'SILVER'

              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.

              items:

## Summary

I implemented `locality` derivation from an owner's city, using the fixed table Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD, defaulting to `UNKNOWN`.

Changes:
1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `locality` property to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries the field in the `GET`/`POST` responses.
2. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/Locality.java`** (new) — a standalone helper holding the city→region table and `Locality.of(city)`.
3. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — added `@Mapping(target = "locality", expression = "java(...Locality.of(owner.getCity()))")` alongside the other derived fields.

### One gotcha worth flagging
My first attempt put the derivation as a `static String localityOf(String)` method *on the `OwnerMapper` interface*. MapStruct scans the mapper interface for candidate mapping methods and picked it up as an implicit `String → String` converter, then applied it to **every** string property — including `telephone`, which became `"UNKNOWN"` and failed the entity's E.164 validation with a 500 at persist time. Moving the helper to a separate class (which MapStruct does not scan) fixed it. That's why `locality` derivation belongs in its own class rather than on the mapper.
